parser-zh.note: The expression-parser session in Chinese — the same two-turn transcript the TUI's scripted agent serves (tui/examples/demo_agent.rs, journal_zh), drawn by the desktop's own chat surface. A settled reply folds onto its answer, so the frame keeps the first reply folded (`查看过程 · 工具调用 2 次 · 思考 1 次`, which is the TUI's own `▸` line) and opens the second reply's work the way the TUI frame opens its tree: `查看过程`, then the step summary, then the first thought. The calls themselves are the desktop's idiom — rows of verbs (`已运行`, `已编辑`) whose command sits in the inspector — while the reasoning, the diagnosis (heading, inline code, highlighted rust block, three-row table), the closing line and both commits are the TUI's words unchanged. The assertion holds the frame to that: every block above the composer, no scroll, one language.

steps.tap: 工具调用 3 次 · 思考 2 次

steps.eval: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; if (text.includes('invalid_history_transfer')) throw new Error("the transcript did not load: the history read failed"); if (!text.includes('诊断')) throw new Error("the Chinese diagnosis is not in the transcript"); if (!text.includes('表达式解析器里的 off-by-one')) throw new Error("the session list does not name the session in Chinese"); if (!text.includes('6b1f0c2') || !text.includes('d41e8aa')) throw new Error("the two commits are not in the transcript"); if (!text.includes('UnexpectedEof')) throw new Error("the diagnosis table is missing"); if (!text.includes('搜这个比较本身')) throw new Error("the reasoning is not open: the second reply's work did not unfold"); if (!text.includes('工具调用 2 次 · 思考 1 次') || !text.includes('工具调用 3 次 · 思考 2 次')) throw new Error("the two replies' step summaries are not both on screen"); if (text.includes("Diagnosis")) throw new Error("the Chinese frame carries the English transcript"); if (text.includes("Off-by-One in the Expression Parser")) throw new Error("the session list carries the English title in the Chinese frame"); const col = [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d => (d.className || '').includes('floating-scrollbar h-full')); if (!col) throw new Error("no conversation column"); if (col.scrollTop !== 0) throw new Error("the frame starts mid-conversation: the column is scrolled by " + col.scrollTop + 'px'); const ps = [...col.querySelectorAll('p')]; if (ps.length < 4) throw new Error("the transcript is not drawn: " + ps.length + " paragraphs"); const first = ps[0].getBoundingClientRect(); const last = ps[ps.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect(); if (first.top < col.getBoundingClientRect().top) throw new Error("the first question is cut at the top: " + Math.round(first.top)); const composer = document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]'); if (!composer) throw new Error("no composer"); const top = composer.getBoundingClientRect().top; if (last.bottom > top - 4) throw new Error("the reply runs under the composer: its last line ends at " + Math.round(last.bottom) + ", the composer starts at " + Math.round(top)); return "ok: " + ps.length + " paragraphs, " + Math.round(first.top) + ".." + Math.round(last.bottom) + ", composer at " + Math.round(top); })()

parser-en.note: The same session in English — the same bug, the same calls, the same table and the same two commits, written in the language of the frame. `?lang=en` pins both halves: the interface (shot/prefs.ts) and the fixture's own session list and transcript, because a rail that said `Sessions` over rows that said `整理两篇文献的结论对比表` is neither language. The three taps are the same three controls as the Chinese scenario, by their English names.
